# One ForAll

> One ForAll là bộ công cụ trực tuyến chạy trên trình duyệt: tải media từ liên kết
> bài đăng được hỗ trợ, chuyển đổi định dạng tệp, xử lý ảnh / tài liệu / nén dữ liệu.
> Dùng được ngay không cần cài đặt và không cần tài khoản; gói trả phí bỏ quảng cáo
> và nâng trần dung lượng tải lên cùng quyền xử lý.
>
> One ForAll is a browser-based tool suite: download media from supported post links,
> convert file formats, and process images, documents and archives. Anonymous use needs
> no install and no account; the paid plan removes ads and raises upload size and
> processing limits.

Default interface language is Vietnamese. Every page below also exists in English under
the `/en/` prefix, e.g. https://oneforall.io.vn/en/youtube-downloader/.

## Pages

- [Home](https://oneforall.io.vn/): entry point, live aggregate system stats, tool index preview.
- [All tools](https://oneforall.io.vn/tools/): complete list of the tools that are actually live.
- [Tools by category](https://oneforall.io.vn/tools/downloader/): category index; siblings are `/tools/converter/`, `/tools/image/`, `/tools/document/`, `/tools/data/`, `/tools/archive/`.
- [Privacy](https://oneforall.io.vn/privacy/): what is collected and for how long.
- [Terms](https://oneforall.io.vn/terms/): acceptable-use terms.

## What is true for every tool

- Input is a public HTTP(S) link or a file you upload. Private, local and link-local
  addresses are rejected.
- The platform is decided from the URL on the server; a client-supplied platform name is
  never trusted.
- Only formats the source really provides are offered. If a list cannot be retrieved, the
  tool says so instead of inventing one, and no quality level is fabricated.
- Media that requires bypassing a login, a paywall, a CAPTCHA or DRM is out of scope.
  Cookies are never harvested from the visitor's browser and are never stored.
- Signed content-delivery URLs, cookies and session data are not returned to the page.
- Jobs and their output files are temporary; run the tool again for a fresh result.
- The live counters on the home page are aggregate system figures only — no personal data.

## Not offered

- No public or documented API for third-party callers. Paths under `/api/`, `/jobs/` and
  `/files/` are internal to this site and are disallowed in `robots.txt`; automate through
  the web pages listed above, not those endpoints.
- No Spotify or other DRM-protected music download. No "premium quality" that the source
  does not publish.
- No batch, CLI or bulk URL processing, and no webhook.

## Machine-readable pointers

- `https://oneforall.io.vn/robots.txt`
- `https://oneforall.io.vn/sitemap.xml`

This file only describes the site. It grants no access, waives no rule in `robots.txt`,
and asks for nothing: crawling policy stays with each client.
